decisive_gate.equation: y_u = q_u * g * h * s + eta_u
decisive_gate.ambiguity: If the allowed receiver class contains g*h, the same data arise from receiver gprime=g*h and single-path propagation hprime=delta, for every downstream LTI control q_u. Adaptive downstream digital controls also fail because their observation histories coincide.
decisive_gate.scope: This is a structural ambiguity under an unrestricted unknown LTI receiver class in one stationary epoch. It is not an impossibility theorem once independently justified receiver bounds, source diversity, or stable-across-time restrictions exclude g*h.
decisive_gate.needed: Independently bounded end-to-end receiver impulse response and timestamp mapping, a verified current emitted waveform, and known-truth calibration trials; or a narrower clearly justified differential-change target.
